runbooks.Title: Fiber span down — isolate, dispatch, restore
runbooks.Steps: [{"n":1,"text":"Confirm LOS on BOTH terminating OTS ports (one-sided LOS points to a card/amp, not the span)."},{"n":2,"text":"Check change calendar for work on the span or SRLG; check 811/locate tickets along the route."},{"n":3,"text":"Run remote OTDR from the terminating ROADM to locate the break (distance from A end)."},{"n":4,"text":"Dispatch fiber repair crew with OTDR distance, nearest hut and ROW permit. (APPROVAL: dispatch)"},{"n":5,"text":"Verify protected traffic switched (APS) and IP rerouted; identify unprotected services for comms."},{"n":6,"text":"If restoration > 2h, consider temporary reroute of priority circuits via ring (APPROVAL: config change)."},{"n":7,"text":"After splice: confirm rx power within −3 dB of baseline on all channels; confirm OTU LOF cleared."},{"n":8,"text":"Verify customer services (probes, RAN KPIs) — not just link state — before resolving."}]

runbooks.Title: Cell site router not recovering after backhaul restore
runbooks.Steps: [{"n":1,"text":"Check uplink optical levels from AGG side."},{"n":2,"text":"Attempt console access via OOB LTE modem."},{"n":3,"text":"Remote power-cycle via smart PDU (APPROVAL: config change)"},{"n":4,"text":"If no OOB, dispatch for local reboot."}]

runbooks.Title: Cell site on battery / commercial power loss
runbooks.Steps: [{"n":1,"text":"Check battery runtime remaining vs utility ETR."},{"n":2,"text":"Dispatch portable generator if runtime < ETR (APPROVAL: dispatch)"}]
